newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran about to take delivery of third submarine.
newsitem.headline: Iran about to take delivery of third submarine.

text.p: Iran's third Russian-made submarine will cruise into its waters on Saturday, a Western military source said.
"The submarine is approaching and will cruise into Iranian waters today," the source, who requested anonymity, told Reuters.
"It is accompanied by a Russian vessel and has been flying a Russian flag," the source added.
The diesel-powered Kilo-class submarine left for Iran from Russia in November and passed through Egypt's Suez Canal on January 2.
Non-Arab Iran is the only regional power to deploy submarines in the Gulf area. The first of the three submarines joined the service in November 1992 and the second in June 1993.
Military analysts say the vessel will enhance Iran's ability to control Gulf waterways.
